rows.text: The answer encloses a 'Copy of letter from Shri V. P. Singh, the Prime Minister to Shri S. R. Bommai, President, Janata Dal', dated 'New Delhi 14-7-1990', opening 'Dear Shri Bommai' and addressed at its foot to 'Shri S. R. Bommai, President, Janata Dal, New Delhi'; it asks him 'to call a meeting of the National Front Parliamentary Party to elect a new leader'.

locator.section: Unstarred Question 2406, enclosed copy of the letter of 14-7-1990 to Shri S. R. Bommai

rows.text: Answering Unstarred Question 2406 on 28 August 1990, the Prime Minister (Shri Viswanath Pratap Singh) said: 'A copy each of two letters dated July 14, 1990 addressed by Shri Vishwanath Pratap Singh to Shri S. R. Bommai, president, Janata Dal and Shri N. T. Rama Rao, Chairman, National Front is enclosed.'
